from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,os,zipfile,csv,json
from datetime import datetime
for p in sorted(Path('output').iterdir()):
 b=p.read_bytes();print(p.name,len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
with zipfile.ZipFile('google_activity_houston.zip') as z:
 assert z.testzip() is None
 for p in Path('output').iterdir(): assert z.read(p.name)==p.read_bytes()
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('output/activity_houston.csv')))
assert len(rows)==12313
assert [datetime.fromisoformat(r['timestamp_houston']).timestamp() for r in rows]==sorted(datetime.fromisoformat(r['timestamp_houston']).timestamp() for r in rows)
ids={r['Gaia ID'] for p in Path('raw').glob('*.csv') for r in csv.DictReader(p.open()) if r.get('Gaia ID')}
assert all(not any(i in p.read_text() for i in ids) for p in Path('output').iterdir())
os.setxattr('google_activity_houston.zip','user.library-file-version',b'2')
print('PASS: 12313 activity records; Gaia values absent; chronological order; ZIP bytes match all five deliverables.')
PY
